title: Reconnect the existing pull-request panel from GitHub settings
verification: Production build and 50 existing GitHub/PR tests passed. Real Electron app-entry navigation through Settings > GitHub > Browse pull requests reached fixture list, commit-based diff and checks. No submission occurred until Post review was clicked. Rejected IPC preserved the draft and enabled retry; successful retry cleared it. Invalid inline line was blocked before IPC; valid line and RIGHT side reached the fixture. No renderer page errors; graceful quit passed.
notes: Reuses all four existing PR components. GitHub responses/submissions were controlled at the main-process IPC boundary; no external comment or review was sent. Reconnection also fixes the composer's stuck posting state, invalid line parsing and stale descriptive comments; list/diff/check rejection paths now surface errors. Compare prefers exact PR SHAs, avoiding ambiguous fork branch names. SR-23 committed and pushed at 62d175fb58d746f3f157795daa2d8e15e15e5e05; full suite passed 3008 tests.
